=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/apply_analysis_on_main.sh
  Line or code reference: 216-222 (orchestrate_run_in_flight)
  Problem: The function is invoked as a condition (`if orchestrate_run_in_flight; then ...`) which suppresses `set -e` inside its body. When the workflow-runs API call fails after gh_retry exhausts retries, the command substitution leaves `active` empty (""), line 221 coerces it to `0`, and the function returns 1 — the dispatcher proceeds as if no orchestrator run is active.
  Why it fails at runtime: An API failure during the window where an orchestrate run is queued or running (but its tracking issue does not exist yet) lets a second orchestrator dispatch through, creating two competing projects.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh
  Line or code reference: 156-158 (code_changes_between)
  Problem: Only `identical` and `behind` comparison statuses return early. A `diverged` status between the stable tag commit and main falls through to file enumeration and starts a full cycle (smoke gate + proving + verifying runs). The promotion job's own preflight (`git merge-base --is-ancestor HEAD "${TARGET_SHA_INPUT}"`) later refuses because stable and main are not fast-forwardable.
  Why it fails at runtime: A hotfix merged into stable and auto-released moves the tag to a commit main does not contain; on every daily tick in that window the cycle starts a proving run that is guaranteed to fail at the end.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml
  Line or code reference: Lines 198, 3509, 4969 — `ref: ${{ needs.source.outputs.branch }}`
  Problem: In gate_only mode the source step echoes the ref name (main) as source.outputs.branch, so every non-release test job checks out whatever main is when that job starts. The release job was pinned to `ref: ${{ github.sha }}` (the dispatched commit) but the test jobs were not.
  Why it fails at runtime: If main advances while the gate is queued or running, test jobs can check out newer commits than the gitHub.sha recorded as smoke_sha, and different jobs can test different commits. The recorded smoke_sha becomes unreliable for the poller's quiescence check.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh
  Line or code reference: 10621 (comprehensive_untested_commits_json, bot-commit branch)
  Problem: The single-commit endpoint `/repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits/{sha}` caps its `files` array at 300 entries without signaling truncation. A COMPREHENSIVE_CYCLE_BOT_LOGINS commit touching more than 300 files with a code file beyond the truncated page is classified as non-code and allowlisted.
  Why it fails at runtime: The quiescence allowlist is the gate between untested commits and a pinned stable promotion; a truncated file list silently converts the code-path check into a no-op for that commit, so promotion can fire over untested code.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 2
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh
  Location: Lines 156-158
  Issue: `diverged` comparison status starts a doomed cycle
  Suggested minimal fix: Add `|| [ "${status}" = "diverged" ]` to the early-return condition at line 156, and emit a distinct skip reason like `PROMOTE_CYCLE_SKIPPED reason=branches_diverged` in the caller.
  Estimated lines changed: 3
  HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh
  Location: Line 10621
  Issue: Unpaginated commit files endpoint silently truncates at 300 files
  Suggested minimal fix: After the `_safe_gh_jq` call, check whether `(.files // []) | length >= 300` and treat truncated responses as untested (the same way the compare truncation at line 10607-10609 already does for compare payloads).
  Estimated lines changed: 3
  HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1

- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh
  Line or code reference: code_changes_between lines 156-158 (only identical and behind return empty; diverged falls through to file enumeration); require_code_changes of tag_commit...main_tip at line 281
  Problem: A diverged stable-tag vs main comparison is treated as a code change and starts the full promote cycle.
  Why it fails at runtime: auto-release-stable.yml tags a stable-only hotfix while main still has its own unreleased commits, so compare(tag, main) is diverged. The tick then spends the smoke gate plus proving and verifying runs. promote-main-to-stable.yml later refuses because stable is not an ancestor of target_sha, so the cycle cannot fast-forward.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml
  Line or code reference: resolve-version checkout line 198, validate-scripts checkout line 3509, validate checkout line 4969 all use ref: needs.source.outputs.branch; gate_only source step still emits the branch name, not github.sha. The release job at line 5076 is the only job pinned to github.sha.
  Problem: Gate-only smoke jobs check out a moving branch name while promote_main_cycle.sh records the run head_sha as smoke_sha.
  Why it fails at runtime: If main advances while the multi-hour gate is queued or running, jobs test different tips than the SHA claimed to have passed. The poller quiescence check and the proving-run marker then rest on a commit the gate did not uniformly test.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- scripts/apply_analysis_on_main.sh
  Line or code reference: orchestrate_run_in_flight lines 216-223; called as if orchestrate_run_in_flight at line 296
  Problem: Because the function is an if condition, set -e is suppressed. A failed workflow-runs lookup leaves active empty, line 221 coerces it to 0, and the function returns not-in-flight.
  Why it fails at runtime: An orchestrate run that is queued or running but has not created its tracking issue yet is missed, so a second competing project is dispatched. Sibling guards (doc search, unprocessed_docs) already fail closed as guard_unavailable.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh
  Location: comprehensive_untested_commits_json bot-commit files fetch around line 10633
  Issue: Single unpaginated GET /commits/{sha} truncates at 300 files; a bot commit with a code path past that page is allowlisted.
  suggested minimal fix: If (.files | length) >= 300, treat the commit as untested instead of allowlisting.
  estimated lines changed: 3
